race.comment: HES A DANCER (6) drew on the second line and had to work when racing wide before finishing third at Young last week. That was his third placing on the trot so his hoof is on the till. Can break through with even luck. MILLIES BOY (8) kicked off his career with a win three-and-a-half weeks ago, getting home by 8 metres at Shepparton. Must overcome a very wide draw but looks to have good ability. POCKET DIAL (10) galloped out then worked to the front before going on for a resuming win at this circuit and distance. Tougher draw but he has upside. DEXTERS DONE (4) last appeared when third at Shepparton nine weeks ago but was readied with two nice trials so must be respected.
